items.claim: CFO給出第四季營收指引區間
items.quote: revenue in the range of $4.22 billion to $4.58 billion
items.speaker: Rafael Lizardi (CFO)

items.claim: CFO給出第四季每股盈餘指引區間
items.quote: earnings per share to be in the range of $1.13 to $1.39
items.speaker: Rafael Lizardi (CFO)

items.claim: CFO說明2026年有效稅率預期
items.quote: our effective tax rate in 2026 to be about 13% to 14%
items.speaker: Rafael Lizardi (CFO)

items.claim: CFO陳述第三季毛利率數字
items.quote: Gross profit in the quarter was $2.7 billion or 57%
items.speaker: Rafael Lizardi (CFO)

items.claim: CFO說明毛利率季減50個基點
items.quote: Sequentially, gross profit margin decreased 50 basis points
items.speaker: Rafael Lizardi (CFO)

items.claim: 分析師質疑排除折舊後的現金毛利率已降至10年低點附近
items.quote: on a cash basis, it's down like to sub 67%
items.speaker: Timothy Arcuri (Analyst, UBS)

items.claim: CFO重申2025年折舊金額指引
items.quote: depreciation for the year is $1.8 billion to $2 billion
items.speaker: Rafael Lizardi (CFO)

items.claim: CFO表示2026年折舊將落在既有框架區間的低端
items.quote: $2.3 billion to $2.7 billion, but to be on the lower end
items.speaker: Rafael Lizardi (CFO)

items.claim: CFO揭露第三季配發股利金額
items.quote: In the quarter, we paid $1.2 billion in dividends
items.speaker: Rafael Lizardi (CFO)

items.claim: CFO揭露第三季庫藏股買回金額
items.quote: repurchased $119 million of our stock
items.speaker: Rafael Lizardi (CFO)

items.claim: CFO陳述季末現金與短期投資水位
items.quote: $5.2 billion of cash and short-term investments
items.speaker: Rafael Lizardi (CFO)

items.claim: CEO給出2025年資料中心業務約當營收規模
items.quote: running more or less at the $1.2 billion run rate in 2025
items.speaker: Haviv Ilan (CEO)

items.claim: CEO稱資料中心為公司成長最快的市場
items.quote: it's also our fastest-growing market
items.speaker: Haviv Ilan (CEO)

items.claim: CEO說明資料中心業務年初至今的成長幅度
items.quote: growing more than 50% for TI year-to-date
items.speaker: Haviv Ilan (CEO)

items.claim: CFO說明每股盈餘中包含的重組費用與6吋廠關閉計畫
items.quote: the planned closures of our last 250-millimeter fabs
items.speaker: Rafael Lizardi (CFO)

items.claim: CEO描述客戶因關稅規則未定而對資本支出決策觀望
items.quote: there is a bit of a wait-and-see mode with our customers
items.speaker: Haviv Ilan (CEO)

items.claim: CEO描述客戶端庫存水位偏低
items.quote: customer inventories remain at low levels
items.speaker: Haviv Ilan (CEO)

items.claim: CEO說明客戶採購型態轉向直接下單與寄售模式
items.quote: customers are direct, more customers are on consignment
items.speaker: Haviv Ilan (CEO)

items.claim: CEO重申公司長期最重視的指標是每股自由現金流成長
items.quote: the long-term growth of free cash flow per share
items.speaker: Haviv Ilan (CEO)

items.claim: IR主管稱公司目前交期具競爭力
items.quote: our lead times right now are competitive
items.speaker: Mike Beckman (IR)

qa_flags.question: Stacy Rasgon（Bernstein）追問第四季毛利率明確落點，以及6吋廠關閉能替模型省下多少成本
qa_flags.response_pattern: CFO確認毛利率『在附近範圍』但未給精確數字，且未量化6吋廠關閉的具體成本節省金額，轉而強調長期每股自由現金流成長的框架敘事

qa_flags.question: Ross Seymore（Deutsche Bank）追問明年OpEx成長軌跡，是否維持低個位數成長或更高
qa_flags.response_pattern: CFO未給出具體百分比或成長區間，只回應『有紀律地將研發與銷管費用分配到最佳機會』的一般性描述
